# Gateway HTTP examples

Base URL placeholder `https://gateway.example` (owner approves the real
domain). Every response body validates against the schema in
`src/relaydeck/contracts/schemas.py`.

```sh
# Authenticated principal (schema: me)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS" \
  'https://gateway.example/v1/me'

# Authorized hosts (schema: hosts)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS" \
  'https://gateway.example/v1/hosts'

# Snapshot (schemas: snapshot / error)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS" \
  'https://gateway.example/v1/hosts/home-mac/snapshot'

# Agent inventory page (schemas: agents-page / error)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS" \
  'https://gateway.example/v1/hosts/home-mac/agents?limit=50'

# Metadata stream with resume cursor (SSE: event metadata|error)
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS" \
  'https://gateway.example/v1/events?host_id=home-mac&cursor=$CURSOR'

# Submit a command (schemas: command-submit / command-record / error)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  https://gateway.example/v1/hosts/home-mac/commands -d @command-submit.json

# Command status (schemas: command-record / error)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS" \
  'https://gateway.example/v1/hosts/home-mac/commands/cmd-20241003-001'

# Exchange an authorization code with PKCE (schemas: token-exchange / token-response)
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  https://gateway.example/v1/token \
  -d '{"grant":"authorization_code","code":"...","verifier":"..."}'

# Create an enrollment invitation (schemas: enrollment-create / enrollment)
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  https://gateway.example/v1/enrollments -d @enrollment-create.json

# Redeem with a proof of possession (schemas: enrollment-redeem / result)
curl -X POST -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  https://gateway.example/v1/enrollments/enr_fixture01/redeem -d @enrollment-redeem.json

# Terminal ticket, then the stream (WebSocket; binary framing v2 in
# terminal_wire.py). Access tokens never appear in query strings; the
# single-use ticket (10s TTL) does.
# TICKET=$(curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ACCESS" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
#   https://gateway.example/v1/terminal-tickets -d @terminal-ticket-request.json \
#   | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["ticket"])')
# wscat -c "wss://gateway.example/v1/terminal/lease-1?ticket=$TICKET"
```

`CURSOR` placeholders are replaced by HMAC-signed opaque cursors at
runtime (see `relaydeck.gateway.cursors`); the checked-in value keeps the
example schema-valid.

Enrollment references (`RELAYDECK-ENROLL:1:...`) carry public context
only (origin, id, code, expiry) — never the seed or tokens.

`command-new-workspace.json` demonstrates the project launch destination.
Its directory is a synthetic absolute Mac path; omission/empty uses the Mac
home directory. Optional agent names are generated by the client before submit.
`command-created.json` exposes bounded resulting IDs; `command-partial-creation.json`
records resources created before a typed failure. Neither returns terminal text.
Observe the original command ID; an unknown outcome never authorizes another launch.
